versions.subject: Add proc_creation_win_chrome_load_extension
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\chrome.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--load-extension='
        - '\AppData\Local\'
condition: selection
